installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Pterodactyl Egg Installer Script
# Copyright (c) 2021–2025 wahke.lu
# Minimum Panel Version: 1.11.11
# Script Version: v1
# ----------------------------------------------------------
set -eu
# ========== LOG ==========
LOG="/mnt/server/install.log"
: > "$LOG"
# ========== LOG ==========
# ===== Einstellungen =====

NAME="UT99 v469e"
VERSION="v0.0.5"
YEAR="2021-2025"

TOTAL_STEPS=9   # Anzahl der Schritte +3
STEP=0

APK_BASE="curl wget ca-certificates grep sed coreutils"
REQUIRE_APK="tar xz unzip bzip2 p7zip gzip"

INSTALL="Installation abgeschlossen."
LOG2="Hinweis: volle Logs siehe $LOG"

HR="------------------------------------------------"

# ===== Einstellungen =====
# ===== Progress-Bar ======
progress_bar() {
  label="$1"
  width=34
  filled=$(( STEP * width / TOTAL_STEPS ))
  empty=$(( width - filled ))
  i=1; fill=""; while [ $i -le $filled ]; do fill="$fill#"; i=$((i+1)); done
  i=1; emp="";  while [ $i -le $empty  ]; do emp="$emp ";  i=$((i+1)); done
  percent=$(( STEP * 100 / TOTAL_STEPS ))
  printf "\r[%s%s] %3d%%  %s" "$fill" "$emp" "$percent" "$label"
}
run_step() {
  label="$1"; shift
  STEP=$((STEP+1))
  progress_bar "$label"
  sh -lc "$*" >>"$LOG" 2>&1
  progress_bar "$label ✓"
  printf "\n"
}
run_block() {
  label="$1"
  STEP=$((STEP+1))
  progress_bar "$label"
  sh -s >>"$LOG" 2>&1
  progress_bar "$label ✓"
  printf "\n"
}
# ===== Progress-Bar ======
# ==== Banner-Funktion ====
if [[ -t 1 ]] && command -v tput >/dev/null 2>&1 && [[ $(tput colors) -ge 8 ]] && [[ -z "${NO_COLOR:-}" ]]; then
  BOLD="$(tput bold)"; DIM="$(tput dim)"; RESET="$(tput sgr0)"
  RED="$(tput setaf 1)"; GREEN="$(tput setaf 2)"; YELLOW="$(tput setaf 3)"
  BLUE="$(tput setaf 4)"; MAGENTA="$(tput setaf 5)"; CYAN="$(tput setaf 6)"; WHITE="$(tput setaf 7)"
else
  BOLD=""; DIM=""; RESET=""; RED=""; GREEN=""; YELLOW=""; BLUE=""; MAGENTA=""; CYAN=""; WHITE=""
fi
banner() {
  printf '%s\n' "$HR"
  printf '%b\n' "${CYAN}${BOLD}    ██     ██  █████  ██   ██ ██   ██ ███████ ${RESET}"
  printf '%b\n' "${CYAN}${BOLD}    ██     ██ ██   ██ ██   ██ ██  ██  ██      ${RESET}"
  printf '%b\n' "${CYAN}${BOLD}    ██  █  ██ ███████ ███████ █████   █████   ${RESET}"
  printf '%b\n' "${CYAN}${BOLD}    ██ ███ ██ ██   ██ ██   ██ ██  ██  ██      ${RESET}"
  printf '%b\n' "${CYAN}${BOLD}     ███ ███  ██   ██ ██   ██ ██   ██ ███████ ${RESET}"
  printf '%s\n' " "
  printf '%b\n' "${DIM}Copyright (c) ${YEAR} wahke.lu${RESET}"
  printf '%b\n' "Script Version : ${YELLOW}${VERSION}${RESET}"
  printf '%s\n' "$HR"
  printf '%b\n' "${BOLD}Starte ${NAME} Installation...${RESET}"
  printf '%b\n' "(Details: ${MAGENTA}${LOG:-/var/log/vcmp-install.log}${RESET})"
  printf '%s\n' "$HR"
  printf '%s\n' " "
}
banner
# ==== Banner-Funktion ====
# === Standard Schritte ===
run_step "Serververzeichnis leeren" \
  "mkdir -p /mnt/server && find /mnt/server -mindepth 1 -exec rm -rf {} +"
run_step "Pakete installieren" \
  "apk add --no-cache ${APK_BASE} ${REQUIRE_APK} >/dev/null"
run_step "Verzeichnisse vorbereiten" \
  "mkdir -p /mnt/server"
cd /mnt/server
# === Standard Schritte ===
# = Installation Schritte =


# 4) Basis-Server herunterladen & entpacken (Mirror-Fallback)
run_block "Server herunterladen & entpacken" <<'SH'
set -eu
BASE_TARBALL="${BASE_TARBALL:-ut-server-linux-436.tar.gz}"
PATCH_TAG="${PATCH_TAG:-auto}"
PATCH_CHANNEL="${PATCH_CHANNEL:-stable}"
PATCH_ARCH="${PATCH_ARCH:-}"

for URL in \
  "https://ut-files.com/Entire_Server_Download/${BASE_TARBALL}" \
  "https://www.ut-files.com/Entire_Server_Download/${BASE_TARBALL}"
do
  if curl -fL -o "${BASE_TARBALL}" "${URL}"; then
    echo "[OK] ${URL}"
    break
  else
    echo "[WARN] Mirror nicht erreichbar: ${URL}"
  fi
done

[ -f "${BASE_TARBALL}" ] || { echo "[FEHLER] ${BASE_TARBALL} konnte nicht geladen werden."; exit 1; }

case "${BASE_TARBALL}" in
  *.tar.gz|*.tgz) tar -xzf "${BASE_TARBALL}" ;;
  *.tar.bz2)      tar -xjf "${BASE_TARBALL}" ;;
  *.zip)          unzip -q "${BASE_TARBALL}" ;;
  *)              echo "[FEHLER] Unbekanntes Archivformat: ${BASE_TARBALL}"; exit 1 ;;
esac

# Inhalte ggf. aus Unterordner hochziehen (inkl. Dotfiles)
if [ ! -d System ]; then
  ROOT="$(find . -maxdepth 2 -type d -name System -print -quit | sed 's|/System||')"
  if [ -n "${ROOT}" ] && [ "${ROOT}" != "." ]; then
    echo "[UT99] Verschiebe Inhalte aus ${ROOT}/* nach /mnt/server"
    find "${ROOT}" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -exec mv -f "{}" . \; 2>/dev/null || true
    rm -rf "${ROOT}"
  fi
fi
SH

# 5) Patch ermitteln, laden & entpacken
run_block "Patch ermitteln & installieren" <<'SH'
set -eu

BASE_TARBALL="${BASE_TARBALL:-ut-server-linux-436.tar.gz}"
PATCH_TAG="${PATCH_TAG:-auto}"
PATCH_CHANNEL="${PATCH_CHANNEL:-stable}"
PATCH_ARCH="${PATCH_ARCH:-}"

# Architektur automatisch bestimmen, falls nicht gesetzt
if [ -z "${PATCH_ARCH:-}" ]; then
  ARCH="$(uname -m 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
  case "${ARCH}" in
    x86_64|amd64)   PATCH_ARCH="Linux-amd64" ;;
    i386|i686)      PATCH_ARCH="Linux-x86" ;;
    aarch64|arm64)  PATCH_ARCH="Linux-arm64" ;;
    *)              PATCH_ARCH="Linux-amd64"; echo "[WARN] Unbekannte Architektur ${ARCH} → nutze ${PATCH_ARCH}";;
  esac
fi

# Patch-Tag bestimmen
if [ "${PATCH_TAG:-auto}" = "auto" ]; then
  if [ "${PATCH_CHANNEL:-stable}" = "rc" ]; then
    PATCH_TAG="$(
      curl -fsSL https://github.com/OldUnreal/UnrealTournamentPatches/releases \
      | grep -o '/OldUnreal/UnrealTournamentPatches/releases/tag/v[0-9A-Za-z._-]*' \
      | grep 'rc[0-9]\+' \
      | head -n1 \
      | awk -F'/tag/' '{print $2}'
    )"
  else
    TAG_URL="$(curl -fsSL -o /dev/null -w '%{url_effective}' \
      https://github.com/OldUnreal/UnrealTournamentPatches/releases/latest || true)"
    PATCH_TAG="$(printf '%s' "${TAG_URL}" | awk -F'/tag/' '{print $2}' | tr -d '\r\n')"
  fi
fi

[ -n "${PATCH_TAG:-}" ] || { echo "[FEHLER] Konnte PATCH_TAG nicht bestimmen."; exit 1; }

VER_FULL="${PATCH_TAG#v}"                                   # z.B. 469e-rc9 oder 469d
VER_FILE="$(printf '%s' "${VER_FULL}" | sed 's/-.*$//')"    # z.B. 469e
BASE_DL="https://github.com/OldUnreal/UnrealTournamentPatches/releases/download/${PATCH_TAG}"

ASSET_URL=""
ASSET_FILE=""
for FN in \
  "OldUnreal-UTPatch${VER_FULL}-${PATCH_ARCH}.tar.bz2" \
  "OldUnreal-UTPatch${VER_FILE}-${PATCH_ARCH}.tar.bz2" \
  "OldUnreal-UTPatchv${VER_FILE}-${PATCH_ARCH}.tar.bz2" \
  "OldUnreal-UTPatch${PATCH_TAG}-${PATCH_ARCH}.tar.bz2"
do
  URL="${BASE_DL}/${FN}"
  if curl -IfsL "${URL}" >/dev/null; then
    ASSET_URL="${URL}"; ASSET_FILE="${FN}"; break
  else
    echo "[INFO] Nicht gefunden: ${URL}"
  fi
done

[ -n "${ASSET_URL}" ] || {
  echo "[FEHLER] Kein Patch-Asset gefunden."
  echo "        TAG=${PATCH_TAG}  ARCH=${PATCH_ARCH}"
  exit 1
}

echo "[UT99] Lade Patch ${PATCH_TAG} (${PATCH_ARCH})"
echo "[UT99] → ${ASSET_URL}"
curl -fL --progress-bar -o patch.tar.bz2 "${ASSET_URL}"
tar -xjf patch.tar.bz2 -C /mnt/server
rm -f patch.tar.bz2 "${BASE_TARBALL:-}"
SH

# 6) Bonus Package Downloaden & Entpacken
run_block "Bonus Package herunterladen & entpacken" <<'SH'
set -eu
wget https://github.com/wahke/Pterodactyl-Egg-s/raw/refs/heads/main/stuff/UT99/maps/UTBonusPack.zip
unzip -o UTBonusPack.zip -d /mnt/server
rm -f UTBonusPack.zip
SH

# 7) ucc-Link
run_block "ucc Symlink anlegen" <<'SH'
set -eu
rm -f /mnt/server/ucc 2>/dev/null || true
if [ -x /mnt/server/System64/ucc-bin ]; then
  ln -s ./System64/ucc-bin /mnt/server/ucc
elif [ -x /mnt/server/System/ucc-bin ]; then
  ln -s ./System/ucc-bin /mnt/server/ucc
fi
SH

# 8) Minimal-INI
run_block "Minimal-INI erzeugen (falls fehlt)" <<'SH'
set -eu
INI="/mnt/server/System64/UnrealTournament.ini"
[ -f "$INI" ] || INI="/mnt/server/System/UnrealTournament.ini"
[ -f "$INI" ] || {
  mkdir -p /mnt/server/System /mnt/server/System64
  cat > "$INI" <<'EOF'
[URL]
Protocol=unreal
Name=Player
Map=Index.unr
LocalMap=CityIntro.unr

[UWeb.WebServer]
bEnabled=False
ListenPort=5080
EOF
}
SH

# 9) Rechte
run_step "Pterodactyl-Standardrechte" \
  "chown -R 1000:1000 /mnt/server || true; chmod 755 /mnt/server || true"

# = Installation Schritte =

echo " "
echo "$HR"
echo "$INSTALL"
echo "$LOG2"
